title: Contracts under agreement.
bodyText: True copies of all contracts made on behalf of the State pursuant to the Agreement shall be kept on file in the office of the Hawaii teacher standards board and in the office of the lieutenant governor.
bodyHtml: §315-3  Contracts under agreement.  True copies of all contracts made on behalf of the State pursuant to the Agreement shall be kept on file in the office of the Hawaii teacher standards board and in the office of the lieutenant governor. [L 1969, c 47, §3; am L 2004, c 21, §3]
